attributes.description: Unique identifier for the meeting space. Primary key.

attributes.name: catering_fnb_outlet_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fnb.fnb_outlet. Business justification: Meeting space catering assignment: hotels designate a specific F&B outlet to handle catering for each meeting space. Event managers and banquet coordinators need this link to route catering orders, en

attributes.name: property_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.property_facility. Business justification: Meeting spaces are a specialized category of property facility. Linking meeting_space to property_facility via property_facility_id allows unified facility management, cross-referencing of operational

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this meeting space is located.

attributes.name: accessibility_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space meets ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) accessibility requirements including wheelchair access, accessible restrooms, and assistive listening systems.

attributes.name: adjacent_prefunction_space
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has an adjacent pre-function or foyer area for registration, breaks, or networking.

attributes.name: blackout_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the space can be fully darkened using blackout curtains or shades. Critical for presentations and AV-heavy events.

attributes.name: builtin_av_equipment
attributes.description: Description of permanently installed AV equipment in the space (e.g., projector, screen, sound system, microphones, video conferencing). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: capacity_banquet
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in banquet-style seating (round tables with 8-10 guests per table).

attributes.name: capacity_classroom
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in classroom-style seating (rows of tables and chairs facing front).

attributes.name: capacity_hollow_square
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in hollow square configuration (tables arranged in square with open center).

attributes.name: capacity_reception
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate for standing reception or cocktail-style events.

attributes.name: capacity_theater
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in theater-style seating (rows of chairs facing front).

attributes.name: capacity_u_shape
attributes.description: Maximum number of attendees the space can accommodate in U-shape seating configuration (tables arranged in U formation).

attributes.name: catering_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether food and beverage (F&B) catering is mandatory when booking this space. Common for ballrooms and premium spaces.

attributes.name: ceiling_height_feet
attributes.description: Height of the ceiling measured in feet. Important for AV equipment setup, lighting design, and event atmosphere.

attributes.name: climate_control_type
attributes.description: Type of heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) control available (individual thermostat, shared zone control, or none).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meeting space record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.

attributes.name: dedicated_wifi_bandwidth_mbps
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dedicated WiFi Bandwidth in Megabits Per Second (Mbps)
attributes.description: Dedicated internet bandwidth available for the meeting space measured in Mbps. Null if shared bandwidth or not applicable.

tag_set.value: Dedicated WiFi Bandwidth in Megabits Per Second (Mbps)

attributes.name: divisible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space can be partitioned into smaller sections using airwalls or movable partitions. Enables flexible space utilization.

attributes.name: emergency_exit_count
attributes.description: Number of emergency exits available in the meeting space. Required for fire safety compliance and event planning.

attributes.name: entrance_width_inches
attributes.description: Width of the main entrance door measured in inches. Important for accessibility compliance and equipment load-in.

attributes.name: fire_capacity_limit
attributes.description: Maximum occupancy allowed by local fire safety codes and building regulations. Must not be exceeded regardless of setup style.

attributes.name: floor_level
attributes.description: Physical floor or level where the meeting space is located within the property (e.g., Ground Floor, Mezzanine, 2nd Floor, Rooftop).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meeting space record was last updated. Part of audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date when the meeting space last underwent renovation or significant refurbishment. Part of PIP (Property Improvement Plan) tracking.

attributes.name: loading_dock_access
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has direct or convenient access to a loading dock for equipment and material delivery.

attributes.name: meeting_space_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the meeting space. Determines availability for booking and event planning.

attributes.name: minimum_catering_spend
attributes.description: Minimum food and beverage spend required when booking this space. Null if no minimum or catering not required.

attributes.name: minimum_rental_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours the space must be rented for a single event. Used for revenue management and booking policies.

attributes.name: natural_light_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the meeting space has windows or skylights providing natural daylight. Important for guest experience and event ambiance.

attributes.name: number_of_sections
attributes.description: Number of separate sections the space can be divided into when partitions are deployed. Null if space is not divisible.

attributes.name: rental_rate_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier classification for the meeting space rental. Actual rates are managed in rate tables and vary by season, day of week, and booking terms.

attributes.name: space_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the meeting space within the property. Used in PMS and event management systems for booking and BEO (Banquet Event Order) references.

attributes.name: space_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the meeting space as displayed to guests and event planners (e.g., Grand Ballroom, Executive Boardroom, Terrace Garden).

attributes.name: space_type
attributes.description: Classification of the meeting space by functional type. Determines suitability for different event formats and MICE (Meetings Incentives Conferences Exhibitions) requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ballroom|boardroom|breakout_room|conference_room|meeting_room|outdoor_terrace|pre_function_space — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_square_footage
attributes.description: Total area of the meeting space measured in square feet. Critical for capacity planning and event layout design.

attributes.name: wifi_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether wireless internet connectivity is available in the meeting space. Essential for modern business events.

products.name: property_outlet
products.description: Single source of truth is fnb.fnb_outlet. Master catalog of revenue-generating outlets within each property including restaurants, bars, spas, golf courses, retail shops, and recreational facilities. Captures outlet name, outlet code, outlet type, cuisine type (for F&B), seating capacity, operating hours, POS system identifier (MICROS), revenue center code (USALI), and outlet status. Serves as the SSOT for outlet identity referenced by the foodandbeverage, finance, and event domains.property_outlet]fnb_outlet. [SSOT:outlet] Domain-specific specialization of the 'outlet' concept; canonical SSOT owner is fnb.fnb_outlet.
products.reference: Revenue Center / Outlet Master (OPERA PMS / MICROS POS)

attributes.name: property_outlet_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the property outlet. Primary key.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each outlet prices in ONE currency (average_check_amount). Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property where this outlet is located. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: alcohol_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet is licensed to serve alcoholic beverages. True if alcohol service is permitted.

attributes.name: average_check_amount
attributes.description: Average guest check amount for the outlet. Used for revenue forecasting and performance benchmarking. Expressed in property base currency.

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the outlet was permanently closed. Null if the outlet is still operational or temporarily closed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this outlet record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: cuisine_type
attributes.description: The primary cuisine or culinary style offered by the outlet. Applicable to Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets. Examples: Italian, Asian Fusion, Steakhouse, Mediterranean, International.

attributes.name: delivery_service_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers delivery service to guest rooms or external locations. True if delivery is available.

attributes.name: dress_code
attributes.description: Dress code policy enforced at the outlet. Communicates guest attire expectations and supports brand positioning.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: Floor number where the outlet is located within the property. Used for wayfinding and facility management.

attributes.name: gratuity_policy
attributes.description: Policy regarding gratuities (tips) at the outlet. Defines whether gratuity is included in pricing, optional, automatically added, or not accepted.

attributes.name: health_permit_number
attributes.description: Health department permit number for food service operations. Required for Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this outlet record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent major renovation or refurbishment of the outlet. Supports Property Improvement Plan (PIP) tracking and Furniture Fixtures and Equipment (FF&E) lifecycle management.

attributes.name: liquor_license_number
attributes.description: Official liquor license number issued by the local regulatory authority. Required for outlets serving alcohol.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the outlet's physical location within the property (e.g., Lobby Level, Poolside, 5th Floor East Wing). Assists guests in finding the outlet.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether purchases at this outlet are eligible for loyalty program points accrual. True if loyalty points can be earned.

attributes.name: menu_url
attributes.description: Web address where the outlet's current menu can be accessed. Applicable to Food and Beverage (F&B) outlets.

attributes.name: mobile_ordering_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet supports mobile ordering through the property's mobile application or third-party platforms. True if mobile ordering is available.

attributes.name: opening_date
attributes.description: Date when the outlet first opened for business. Used for historical tracking and anniversary celebrations.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the outlet. Format varies by property but typically includes days of week and time ranges (e.g., Mon-Fri 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM).

attributes.name: outdoor_seating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers outdoor seating. True if outdoor seating is available.

attributes.name: outlet_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the outlet within the property. Used for operational reference and system integration.

attributes.name: outlet_name
attributes.description: The business name of the outlet as displayed to guests and used in marketing materials.

attributes.name: outlet_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the outlet. Determines whether the outlet is available for guest use and revenue generation.

attributes.name: outlet_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outlet by its primary business function. Determines operational processes and revenue reporting categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: restaurant|bar|lounge|cafe|spa|fitness_center|golf_course|retail_shop|pool_bar|room_service|banquet|conference_center|business_center|recreational_facility|other — 15 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pos_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Point of Sale (POS) system instance used by this outlet. Typically references Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS system configuration.

attributes.name: private_dining_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet offers private dining rooms or spaces for exclusive events. True if private dining is available.

attributes.name: reservation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance reservations are required or recommended for this outlet. True if reservations are mandatory or strongly encouraged.

attributes.name: revenue_center_code
attributes.description: USALI-compliant revenue center code used for financial reporting and general ledger (GL) integration. Maps outlet revenue to the appropriate financial statement line item.

attributes.name: seasonal_close_date
attributes.description: Annual date when the outlet closes for seasonal operation. Applicable only to seasonal outlets.

attributes.name: seasonal_open_date
attributes.description: Annual date when the outlet opens for seasonal operation. Applicable only to seasonal outlets.

attributes.name: seasonal_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outlet operates on a seasonal schedule (e.g., summer only, winter only). True if seasonal.

attributes.name: seating_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests that can be seated simultaneously in the outlet. Used for reservation management and capacity planning.

attributes.name: service_charge_percentage
attributes.description: Standard service charge percentage applied to guest bills at this outlet. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 18.00 for 18%).

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total square footage of the outlet space. Used for space utilization analysis and capital expenditure (CapEx) planning.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Web address for the outlet's dedicated website or property page. Used for online marketing and guest information.

products.name: gds_profile
products.description: GDS (Global Distribution System) and CRS property profile records defining how each property is listed and distributed across Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport, and direct booking channels. Captures GDS property code, chain code, CRS property code (Sabre SynXis), property display name, short description, long description, hero image URL, amenity flags, and last sync timestamp. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration. Supports channel distribution and OTA partnership management.
products.reference: GDS Property Profile / CRS Property Listing (Sabre SynXis)

attributes.name: gds_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the GDS/CRS property profile record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a property listing/distribution profile asset managed and distributed across GDS and CRS channels.

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: gds_profile.distribution_channel_type is a denormalized reference to channel.channel. Normalizing via FK enables channel-level GDS content reporting, rate parity audits by channel, and content syndica

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to property.currency. Business justification: Each GDS profile displays rates in ONE currency. Normalize currency reference to master currency table. Remove currency_code string - will be retrieved via JOIN.

attributes.name: gds_connection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.gds_connection. Business justification: GDS content management requires linking a property's GDS profile to its specific GDS connection record. Operations teams use this to audit which GDS network a profile is active on, validate content sy

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent property master record that this GDS profile describes. Links the distribution profile to the physical hotel or resort asset in the property domain.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address of the property as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Used by guests and travel agents for navigation and correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: amadeus_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Amadeus GDS network. May differ from the Sabre GDS property code. Used for Amadeus channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Amadeus platform.

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: The brand identifier code as registered in the GDS and CRS systems. Identifies the hotel brand (e.g., luxury, premium, select-service) under which the property is marketed in distribution channels. Used for brand-level filtering in GDS searches.

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The full marketing name of the hotel brand as displayed in GDS and OTA channels (e.g., 'Luxury Collection', 'Marriott Hotels', 'Hilton Garden Inn'). Supports brand-level reporting and channel distribution analytics.

attributes.name: chain_code
attributes.description: The hotel chain or brand code registered with the GDS networks identifying the parent brand or management company. Used by GDS systems to group properties under a common brand umbrella for travel agent searches and loyalty program linkage.

attributes.name: check_in_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-in time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set arrival expectations.

attributes.name: check_out_time
attributes.description: The standard guest check-out time for the property in HH:MM (24-hour) format as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Displayed to guests and travel agents during the booking process to set departure expectations.

attributes.name: city_code
attributes.description: The IATA or GDS city/airport code associated with the property location (e.g., 'NYC', 'LON', 'PAR'). Used by GDS systems to associate the property with a travel destination for search and booking purposes.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: The full city name of the property location as displayed in GDS and OTA channel listings. Supports geographic search and filtering in distribution channels.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the property location as registered in the GDS profile. Used for geographic filtering in GDS and OTA search results and for regulatory compliance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GDS profile record was first created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and profile lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: crs_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier assigned within the Central Reservation System (CRS), specifically Sabre SynXis CRS. This code is the primary key used for rate distribution, inventory allocation, and booking transactions flowing through the CRS. Distinct from the GDS property code.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The property name as it appears in GDS and CRS search results and booking screens. This is the consumer-facing name used by travel agents and OTA partners. May differ from the legal property name or internal operating name.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: The fax number for the property as listed in GDS channel profiles. Used by travel agents and corporate accounts for reservation confirmations and group booking correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: floor_count
attributes.description: The total number of floors in the main hotel building as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Used by travel agents and guests for property orientation and accessibility planning.

attributes.name: galileo_property_code
attributes.description: The property identifier specific to the Galileo/Travelport GDS network. Used for Travelport channel distribution, rate loading, and availability display to travel agents on the Galileo platform.

attributes.name: gds_property_code
attributes.description: The unique property identifier assigned within the GDS network (Sabre, Amadeus, Galileo/Travelport). This code is used by travel agents and OTA partners to look up and book the property across GDS channels. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration.

attributes.name: has_airport_shuttle
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers complimentary or paid airport shuttle service as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by transportation amenities.

attributes.name: has_fitness_center
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a fitness center or gym as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by wellness amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: has_meeting_facilities
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has meeting rooms or conference facilities (MICE — Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by corporate travel agents and event planners to filter properties for group and event bookings.

attributes.name: has_parking
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property offers on-site parking (self-park or valet) as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by parking availability.

attributes.name: has_pool
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property has a swimming pool as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by recreational amenities. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: hero_image_url
attributes.description: The URL of the primary hero/banner image displayed on GDS and OTA property listing pages. This is the main visual asset representing the property in channel distribution. Must be a publicly accessible HTTPS URL conforming to OTA image specification standards.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property meets Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility requirements as published in GDS and OTA profiles. Used by travel agents and guests requiring accessible accommodations. Supports ADA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: is_pet_friendly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property accepts pets as published in GDS and OTA amenity flags. Used by travel agents and guests to filter properties by pet policy. Sourced from Sabre SynXis CRS amenity configuration.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent successful synchronization of this property profile from the Sabre SynXis CRS channel configuration to the GDS networks and downstream distribution channels. Used to monitor data freshness and identify stale profiles requiring re-sync.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for map-based search and proximity filtering in GDS, OTA, and direct booking channels. Supports geo-analytics and competitive set mapping.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: The full marketing narrative for the property displayed on GDS detail screens and OTA property pages. Covers property overview, location highlights, accommodation types, dining, recreation, and meeting facilities. Supports channel distribution and OTA partnership management.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the property in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for map-based search and proximity filtering in GDS, OTA, and direct booking channels. Supports geo-analytics and competitive set mapping.

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: The primary reservations or front desk phone number for the property as listed in GDS and OTA channels. Used by travel agents and guests to contact the property directly. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code of the property location as registered in the GDS profile. Used for geographic proximity searches in GDS and OTA platforms. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: profile_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GDS/CRS property profile version became active and live for distribution across GDS and OTA channels. Used for profile versioning, content audit trails, and channel distribution management.

attributes.name: profile_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GDS/CRS property profile version expires or is scheduled for deactivation. Nullable for open-ended active profiles. Used for profile lifecycle management and scheduled content refresh cycles.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GDS/CRS property profile. Controls whether the property is actively distributed and bookable across GDS channels. 'active' = live and bookable; 'inactive' = not distributed; 'suspended' = temporarily removed from distribution; 'pending_review' = awaiting content approval; 'draft' = profile under construction.

attributes.name: property_category
attributes.description: The GDS/OTA property category classification used to filter search results. Determines how the property is categorized in GDS and OTA search interfaces. Aligned with OTA (OpenTravel Alliance) property type codes.

attributes.name: reservation_email
attributes.description: The reservations department email address for the property as listed in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Used by travel agents and corporate accounts for booking inquiries and group reservation correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: A concise marketing description of the property (typically 150–250 characters) displayed in GDS search result summaries and OTA listing previews. Highlights key selling points such as location, brand tier, and signature amenities.

attributes.name: star_rating
attributes.description: The official star rating of the property as displayed in GDS and OTA channels (e.g., 3.0, 4.0, 5.0). Sourced from recognized rating bodies or brand classification standards. Influences GDS search filtering and OTA ranking algorithms.

attributes.name: total_room_count
attributes.description: The total number of guest rooms and suites at the property as published in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Used by travel agents for property selection and by revenue management for inventory benchmarking. Represents the principal quantitative fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GDS profile record was last modified in the Silver layer lakehouse. Used to track content changes, monitor sync freshness, and support data quality audits.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The official property website URL as listed in GDS and OTA channel profiles. Directs guests and travel agents to the brand.com direct booking page. Supports direct channel conversion and OTA partnership management.

products.name: currency
products.description: Reference master for currencies used across the global property portfolio, including ISO 4217 currency codes, currency names, decimal precision, exchange rate source configuration, and base currency designation for financial consolidation.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the currency record. Primary key.

attributes.name: base_currency_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on currency (base_currency_id)

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 alphabetic currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). This is the standard international identifier for the currency used across all financial systems, property management systems, and revenue management platforms.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code for the primary country where this currency is the official legal tender (e.g., USA for USD, GBR for GBP). Used for geographic revenue analysis and Smith Travel Research (STR) market benchmarking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and compliance with Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) requirements for financial data.

attributes.name: currency_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the currency in the system. Active currencies are available for all transactions; inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting; deprecated currencies are being phased out; historical currencies are no longer in circulation (e.g., legacy European currencies replaced by EUR); pending currencies are configured but not yet live.

attributes.name: decimal_places
attributes.description: Number of decimal places used for this currency in financial calculations and display. Most currencies use 2 (e.g., USD 100.50), some use 0 (e.g., JPY 1000), and a few use 3 (e.g., BHD 10.250). Critical for accurate revenue calculations, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) reporting.

attributes.name: display_format
attributes.description: The standard display format for this currency including symbol placement, decimal separator, and thousands separator (e.g., $1,234.56 for USD, 1.234,56 € for EUR). Used to ensure consistent presentation across guest-facing systems, reports, and Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this currency configuration became or will become effective in the system. Used for managing currency transitions, redenominations, and historical accuracy in financial reporting.

attributes.name: erp_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system, such as SAP S/4HANA. Used for financial consolidation, General Ledger (GL) posting, Accounts Payable (AP), and Accounts Receivable (AR) integration.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_source
attributes.description: The authoritative source or provider for exchange rate data for this currency (e.g., OANDA, XE.com, Bloomberg, Reuters, Central Bank). Used to ensure consistent exchange rate application across Central Reservation System (CRS), Revenue Management System (RMS), and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems.

attributes.name: exchange_rate_update_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which exchange rates are refreshed for this currency. Critical for accurate revenue recognition, dynamic pricing in Revenue Management System (RMS), and financial consolidation under International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this currency configuration expires or is no longer valid for new transactions. Nullable for currencies with indefinite validity. Used for managing currency transitions and ensuring historical data integrity.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is currently active and available for use in transactions, reservations, and financial operations. Inactive currencies are retained for historical reporting but cannot be used for new transactions.

attributes.name: is_base_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is the base currency for financial consolidation and corporate reporting. Typically one currency per enterprise (e.g., USD for US-headquartered companies). Used for Gross Operating Profit (GOP), Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA), and consolidated financial statements under Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI).

attributes.name: is_crypto_currency
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a cryptocurrency (e.g., Bitcoin, Ethereum) rather than a traditional fiat currency. Used for special handling in payment processing, regulatory compliance, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: minor_unit
attributes.description: The relationship between the major currency unit and its minor unit (e.g., 100 cents = 1 dollar). Defines the subdivision of the currency for precise financial calculations in Property Management System (PMS) and Point of Sale (POS) systems.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full official name of the currency (e.g., United States Dollar, Euro, British Pound Sterling, Japanese Yen). Used for display purposes in financial reports and guest-facing materials.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information about this currency. May include information about currency restrictions, regulatory requirements, or system-specific configuration details.

attributes.name: numeric_code
attributes.description: Three-digit ISO 4217 numeric currency code used in systems where alphabetic codes are not practical. Provides an alternative identifier for the currency in legacy systems and international payment processing.

attributes.name: payment_processing_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this currency is enabled for payment processing through Point of Sale (POS) systems, online booking engines, and payment gateways. Must comply with Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) requirements.

attributes.name: pms_currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code or identifier used in the Property Management System (PMS), such as Oracle OPERA. May differ from ISO 4217 code in legacy systems. Used for system integration and data mapping between PMS and enterprise data warehouse.

attributes.name: rounding_method
attributes.description: The rounding method to be applied when performing calculations with this currency. Standard follows mathematical rounding rules; up always rounds up; down always rounds down; nearest rounds to nearest value; bankers rounding (round half to even) minimizes cumulative rounding errors in large transaction volumes. Critical for accurate Average Daily Rate (ADR) and Total Revenue Per Available Room (TRevPAR) calculations.

attributes.name: symbol
attributes.description: Standard symbol used to represent the currency (e.g., $, €, £, ¥). Used in user interfaces, reports, and guest-facing displays for quick visual recognition.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this currency record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.

domains.name: inventory
domains.description: Real-time room inventory management including room types, physical room attributes, availability, room status, housekeeping status, out-of-order designations, and inventory controls. Manages room blocks, allotments, overbooking limits, and LRA (Last Room Availability). Integrates with PMS (Oracle OPERA) and RMS (IDeaS G3) for dynamic inventory allocation across distribution channels. Tracks OCC and supports LOS-based controls.

products.name: room_type
products.description: Master catalog of room types defined per property, including physical configuration (bed type, bed count, view category, square footage), maximum occupancy, accessibility features, ADA compliance status, connecting room eligibility, and suite classification. Serves as the foundational classification entity for all inventory management — availability, controls, blocks, allotments, channel distribution, and demand forecasting all reference room type as their primary dimension. Defined and maintained in Oracle OPERA PMS across luxury, premium, and select-service segments.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Primary key for room_type

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the property where this room type is defined. Room types are property-specific configurations.

attributes.name: accessibility_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of accessibility features available in this room type. Examples: roll-in shower, grab bars, visual alarm, hearing kit, lowered fixtures. Used for guest matching and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the room type. Inactive types are not available for new reservations. Seasonal types are active only during specific periods. Renovation types are temporarily unavailable.

attributes.name: bathroom_configuration
attributes.description: Description of bathroom setup. Examples: single full bath, 1.5 bath, dual vanity, separate tub and shower. Used for guest expectations and competitive positioning.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Number of beds in the room type. Used for occupancy calculations and guest preference matching.

attributes.name: bed_type
attributes.description: Primary bed configuration for the room type. Critical for guest preference matching and inventory allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: king|queen|double|twin|california_king|murphy|sofa_bed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code used to identify the room type in PMS and RMS systems. Examples: KING, QQDBL, JSUITE, PRES. This is the operational identifier used across reservations, inventory, and revenue management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room type record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed marketing description of the room type including amenities, features, and guest experience highlights. Used for guest-facing channels and OTA distribution.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this room type configuration expires or is replaced. Null for currently active configurations. Used for historical tracking and renovation planning.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this room type configuration becomes effective. Used for managing room type changes, renovations, and new inventory rollouts.

attributes.name: floor_level_range
attributes.description: Typical floor range where this room type is located. Examples: 1-5, 6-10, 15-20. Used for guest preference and accessibility planning.

attributes.name: is_ada_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type meets ADA accessibility requirements including mobility, hearing, and visual accommodations. Required for compliance reporting and guest accessibility requests.

tag_set.value: Is ADA (Americans with Disabilities Act) Compliant

attributes.name: is_connecting_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type can be configured as a connecting room. Used for family and group booking allocation.

attributes.name: is_suite
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type is classified as a suite with separate living and sleeping areas. Used for inventory segmentation and revenue reporting.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room type record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across PMS, RMS, and CRS systems.

attributes.name: lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type participates in Last Room Availability agreements with OTA partners. Critical for channel distribution and rate parity management.

attributes.name: max_occupancy
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests allowed in this room type per fire code and property standards. Used for reservation validation and yield optimization.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the room type as displayed to guests and staff. Examples: Deluxe King, Queen Queen Double, Junior Suite, Presidential Suite.

attributes.name: overbooking_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type can be overbooked as part of revenue management strategy. Used by RMS for yield optimization.

attributes.name: pseudo_room_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a pseudo room type used for inventory management purposes (e.g., house use, out of order, complimentary) rather than a sellable room type. Used for inventory controls and reporting exclusions.

attributes.name: rate_category
attributes.description: Rate category classification used for revenue management and pricing strategy. Examples: BAR, Corporate, Government, Group, Promotional. Links to rate plan structures.

attributes.name: room_class
attributes.description: High-level classification of the room type by service tier. Used for segmentation in revenue management and guest experience programs.

attributes.name: room_features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of key room features and amenities. Examples: balcony, kitchenette, fireplace, whirlpool, separate shower, walk-in closet. Used for guest communication and OTA distribution.

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Property segment classification for this room type. Aligns with brand standards and service level expectations.

attributes.name: sellable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type is available for sale to guests. Non-sellable types include staff rooms, maintenance rooms, and owner units.

attributes.name: smoking_policy
attributes.description: Smoking policy for this room type. Most properties are non-smoking; some maintain designated smoking inventory.

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence for this room type in PMS screens, reports, and guest-facing channels. Lower numbers appear first.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total floor area of the room type in square feet. Used for guest communication, competitive positioning, and property planning.

attributes.name: standard_occupancy
attributes.description: Standard number of guests for this room type used for base rate calculations. Additional guests may incur extra person charges.

attributes.name: view_category
attributes.description: Classification of the view from the room. Impacts pricing strategy and guest satisfaction. Used in revenue management for rate differentiation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ocean|city|mountain|garden|pool|courtyard|no_view|partial — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: room
products.description: Physical room master record representing each individual guestroom or suite at a property. Captures room number, floor, wing, building, room type assignment, physical attributes (square footage, bed configuration, connecting rooms), ADA accessibility status, smoking designation, view type, and current operational status. The authoritative SSOT for physical room identity in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the physical room. Primary key. Authoritative SSOT for physical room identity in Oracle OPERA PMS.

attributes.name: connecting_room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the adjacent room that connects to this room via connecting door. Null if no connecting room.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property (hotel, resort, or vacation property) where this room is located.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type classification (e.g., Standard King, Deluxe Suite, Executive Double) assigned to this room. Determines rate category and inventory grouping.

attributes.name: ada_accessible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room meets ADA accessibility standards including wheelchair access, grab bars, visual alarms, and accessible bathroom fixtures.

attributes.name: balcony_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room has a private balcony or terrace. Premium feature used for rate differentiation.

attributes.name: bed_count
attributes.description: Total number of beds in the room. Used for occupancy capacity and guest preferences.

attributes.name: bed_type
attributes.description: Primary bed configuration in the room. Critical for guest preferences and room assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: king|queen|double|twin|california_king|murphy|sofa_bed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: building_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the building or tower within a multi-building property. Null for single-building properties.

attributes.name: connecting_room_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room has a connecting door to an adjacent room. Used for family bookings and group assignments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: features
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional room features and amenities (e.g., minibar, safe, coffee maker, smart TV, work desk). Used for guest preference matching and marketing.

attributes.name: ffe_condition_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) Condition Score
attributes.description: Condition assessment score for room furniture, fixtures, and equipment on a scale of 0.00 to 5.00. Used for CapEx planning and PIP prioritization.

attributes.name: floor_number
attributes.description: The floor level where the room is located within the building. Used for housekeeping routing and guest preferences.

attributes.name: front_office_status
attributes.description: Current front office occupancy state. Indicates whether the room is vacant, occupied by a guest, reserved for arrival, or blocked.

attributes.name: housekeeping_status
attributes.description: Current housekeeping state of the room. Updated by housekeeping staff and used for room assignment and availability.

attributes.name: kitchenette_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the room includes a kitchenette with cooking facilities. Common in extended-stay properties.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this room record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: last_renovation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renovation or major refurbishment. Used for PIP (Property Improvement Plan) tracking and FF&E (Furniture Fixtures and Equipment) lifecycle management.

attributes.name: lra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room is eligible for Last Room Availability distribution to OTA partners. Used for channel distribution controls.

attributes.name: max_occupancy
attributes.description: Maximum number of guests allowed in the room per fire code and property policy. Used for reservation validation.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the room. Determines whether the room is available for sale and occupancy. Lifecycle status field.

attributes.name: out_of_order_end_date
attributes.description: Expected date when the room will return to service. Used for inventory forecasting and revenue management.

attributes.name: out_of_order_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why the room is out of order. Null when room is in service. Used for maintenance tracking and OCC impact analysis.

attributes.name: out_of_order_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the room was taken out of order. Used for revenue impact analysis and maintenance duration tracking.

attributes.name: overbooking_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room can be included in overbooking calculations. Used by RMS for yield optimization.

attributes.name: room_number
attributes.description: The externally-known room number displayed on the door and used for guest communication. Business identifier for the room.

attributes.name: smoking_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether smoking is permitted in the room. Used for guest preference matching and inventory segmentation.

attributes.name: square_footage
attributes.description: Total interior square footage of the room. Used for marketing, rate positioning, and guest selection criteria.

attributes.name: view_type
attributes.description: Type of view from the room windows. Impacts rate positioning and guest satisfaction. Used for upsell opportunities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ocean|city|mountain|garden|pool|courtyard|no_view — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: wing_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the wing or section within a building. Used for operational routing and guest location preferences.

products.name: room_status
products.description: Real-time operational status record for each physical room capturing the current housekeeping state (dirty, clean, inspected, pick-up), front-desk status (vacant, occupied, due-out, due-in), and maintenance flags. Tracks status transitions with timestamps, assigned housekeeper, last inspection time, and turndown service status. Integrates with Oracle OPERA PMS housekeeping module for live room status boards.

attributes.name: room_status_id
attributes.description: Primary key for room_status

attributes.name: attendant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the housekeeping staff member currently assigned to clean or service this room.

attributes.name: hk_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to housekeeping.hk_assignment. Business justification: Room status transitions (dirty→clean, vacant→inspected) are driven by hk_assignment completion events. Direct FK enables front-desk room readiness reporting, discrepancy resolution (discrepancy_flag o

attributes.name: inspection_id

attributes.name: out_of_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.out_of_order. Business justification: room_status currently carries denormalized OOO fields: is_out_of_order (BOOLEAN), out_of_order_start_date, out_of_order_end_date, and out_of_order_reason. The out_of_order table is the authoritative O

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the guest currently occupying the room. Null if room is vacant.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property where the room is located. Links to the property master data.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active reservation currently occupying the room. Null if room is vacant.

attributes.name: room_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical room. Links to the room inventory master data.

attributes.name: blocked_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the room is administratively blocked from sale (e.g., VIP hold, renovation, inventory control, group block).

attributes.name: cleaning_type
attributes.description: Type of cleaning service required or last performed. Checkout: full cleaning after guest departure; Stayover: daily service for occupied room; Deep Clean: comprehensive periodic cleaning; Turndown: evening service; Refresh: light touch-up.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this room status record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: discrepancy_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating a mismatch between front desk status and housekeeping status (e.g., front desk shows vacant but housekeeping shows occupied). Requires investigation.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of any status discrepancy and actions taken to resolve it.

attributes.name: do_not_disturb_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the guest has activated the do not disturb indicator, preventing housekeeping and other staff from entering.

attributes.name: expected_checkin_date
attributes.description: The scheduled check-in date for the next arriving guest. Used for due-in planning and housekeeping prioritization.

attributes.name: expected_checkout_date
attributes.description: The scheduled checkout date for the current guest occupying the room. Used for due-out planning.

attributes.name: front_desk_status
attributes.description: Current operational status from the front desk perspective. Vacant: unoccupied and available; Occupied: guest currently in residence; Reserved: booked for future arrival; Due Out: guest scheduled to check out today; Due In: guest scheduled to check in today; Out of Order: room unavailable for sale.

attributes.name: housekeeping_status
attributes.description: Current housekeeping state of the room indicating cleanliness and readiness. Dirty: needs full cleaning; Clean: cleaned but not inspected; Inspected: cleaned and quality-checked; Pickup: minor refresh needed; Out of Service: maintenance required; Do Not Disturb: guest requested no service.

attributes.name: is_blocked
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room is administratively blocked from sale (e.g., for renovation, VIP hold, or inventory control).

attributes.name: is_clean
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room has been cleaned and is ready for occupancy. True if housekeeping status is clean or inspected.

attributes.name: is_inspected
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room has passed housekeeping quality inspection after cleaning.

attributes.name: is_out_of_order
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the room is out of order and unavailable for sale due to maintenance or other operational issues.

attributes.name: last_cleaned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last cleaned by housekeeping staff.

attributes.name: last_inspected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room last passed housekeeping quality inspection.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this room status record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: last_occupied_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last occupied by a guest (most recent check-in or last known occupancy).

attributes.name: last_vacated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room was last vacated by a guest (most recent check-out).

attributes.name: maintenance_status
attributes.description: Current maintenance condition of the room. Available: no maintenance issues; Minor Repair: small issues not blocking occupancy; Major Repair: significant issues requiring attention; Out of Order: room cannot be occupied; Scheduled Maintenance: planned preventive maintenance.

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Simple binary occupancy indicator. Vacant: no guest assigned; Occupied: guest currently checked in; Reserved: future reservation exists.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Housekeeping priority level for servicing this room. Urgent: immediate attention required (e.g., due-in within 1 hour); High: priority cleaning (e.g., VIP guest, early check-in); Normal: standard cleaning schedule; Low: can be deferred.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for housekeeping staff regarding this room (e.g., guest allergies, VIP preferences, extra amenities required).

attributes.name: status_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the room status was last updated in the system. Tracks the most recent status transition.

attributes.name: turndown_service_status
attributes.description: Status of evening turndown service for the room. Not Requested: no turndown service scheduled; Requested: guest or property standard requires turndown; Completed: turndown service has been performed; Declined: guest declined turndown service.

products.name: availability_snapshot
products.description: Date-level inventory availability record per room type per property capturing total physical rooms, rooms sold, rooms blocked (group and allotment), out-of-order rooms, out-of-service rooms, complimentary rooms, house-use rooms, day-use rooms, and net available rooms. The authoritative SSOT for real-time occupancy (OCC) calculation and available-to-sell inventory. Feeds IDeaS G3 RMS for yield optimization and supports LRA (Last Room Availability) flag tracking. Reconciled nightly during night audit against PMS folios and room status. Serves as the foundation for RevPAR, occupancy trending, and inventory reconciliation reporting.
products.reference: IDeaS G3 Inventory Snapshot / OPERA Availability

attributes.name: availability_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the availability snapshot record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the hotel property for which this availability snapshot is recorded.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type (e.g., Standard King, Deluxe Suite) for which availability is tracked.

attributes.name: closed_to_arrival_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether new reservations are allowed to check in on this date. When true, no new arrivals are accepted, but existing multi-night stays can continue.

attributes.name: closed_to_departure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether guests are allowed to check out on this date. When true, reservations must extend beyond this date to capture higher-value multi-night stays.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability snapshot record was first created in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: discrepancy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any discrepancies found during reconciliation, including root cause and resolution actions.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Last Room Availability is enabled for this room type on this date. When true, the property commits to selling rooms at contracted rates even if only one room remains.

attributes.name: max_los_restriction
attributes.description: Maximum number of nights allowed for a reservation starting on this date. Used to prevent long stays during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: min_los_restriction
attributes.description: Minimum number of nights required for a reservation starting on this date. Used for demand management and revenue optimization.

attributes.name: net_available_rooms
attributes.description: Net number of rooms available to sell after accounting for all deductions (OOO, OOS, house use, blocks). Calculated as total physical rooms minus all unavailable and blocked rooms.

attributes.name: occ_rate
attributes.description: Occupancy rate percentage for this room type on this date, calculated as (rooms sold + complimentary rooms) / net available rooms * 100. Key performance metric for revenue management.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms that can be overbooked for this room type on this date, based on historical no-show and cancellation patterns. Used for yield optimization.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the nightly reconciliation process for this snapshot. Indicates whether the snapshot has been validated against PMS folios and room status.

attributes.name: rooms_blocked_allotment
attributes.description: Number of rooms allocated to contracted allotments (OTA, wholesaler, corporate contracts) that are held but not yet sold.

attributes.name: rooms_blocked_group
attributes.description: Number of rooms blocked for group reservations (MICE, corporate blocks) that are not yet sold but are held off general inventory.

attributes.name: rooms_complimentary
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied by complimentary guests (e.g., loyalty rewards, service recovery, VIP comps). Counted in occupancy but not in revenue.

attributes.name: rooms_day_use
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold for day-use only (check-in and check-out on the same day), typically for meetings or short stays.

attributes.name: rooms_house_use
attributes.description: Number of rooms occupied by hotel staff, contractors, or used for operational purposes (e.g., training, storage). Not available for sale.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_order
attributes.description: Number of rooms temporarily unavailable due to maintenance, repair, or refurbishment. These rooms are not available for sale.

attributes.name: rooms_out_of_service
attributes.description: Number of rooms permanently or long-term unavailable due to major renovation, structural issues, or strategic decisions. Not available for sale.

attributes.name: rooms_overbooked
attributes.description: Actual number of rooms overbooked (sold beyond physical capacity) for this room type on this date.

attributes.name: rooms_sold
attributes.description: Number of rooms sold (occupied by paying guests) for this room type on this date. Used in OCC (Occupancy Rate) calculation.

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The business date for which this availability snapshot is recorded. Represents the stay date, not the snapshot creation date.

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when this availability snapshot was captured. Typically recorded during the nightly audit process.

attributes.name: stop_sell_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type is completely closed for sale on this date across all channels. When true, no new reservations are accepted.

attributes.name: total_physical_rooms
attributes.description: Total number of physical rooms of this room type at the property, representing the maximum inventory capacity.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this availability snapshot record was last updated in the data warehouse.

products.name: control
products.description: Unified inventory control and restriction record defining all sell constraints per room type per stay date: sell limits, hurdle rates, minimum length-of-stay (MinLOS), maximum length-of-stay (MaxLOS), closed-to-arrival (CTA), closed-to-departure (CTD), stop-sell flags, overbooking limits (percentage and absolute), walk risk tolerance, and channel-level inventory gating rules. Generated by IDeaS G3 RMS and enforced in Oracle OPERA PMS and Sabre SynXis CRS. The single diagnostic target for answering 'why can't this room type be sold on this date?' — consolidates all restriction types into one queryable entity. Supports HTNG inventory control message standards and dynamic allocation across OTA, GDS, and direct channels.
products.reference: IDeaS G3 Inventory Controls / OPERA Restrictions

attributes.name: control_id
attributes.description: Primary key for control

attributes.name: budget_id

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution channel (OTA, GDS, Direct) to which this control applies. Null indicates control applies to all channels.

attributes.name: demand_forecast_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.demand_forecast. Business justification: Inventory controls (stop-sell, hurdle rates, sell limits) are set based on specific demand forecast runs. Linking control to demand_forecast enables RMS audit trails, forecast-to-control traceability,

attributes.name: promotion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.promotion. Business justification: Revenue managers create availability control overrides (stop-sell lifts, overbooking limit changes) specifically triggered by loyalty promotions. This FK enables tracking which promotion drove a contr

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the property to which this inventory control applies.

attributes.name: revenue_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the rate plan to which this control applies. Null indicates control applies to all rate plans for the room type and date.

attributes.name: room_block_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the group block that this control is associated with. Null if control is not tied to a specific group reservation.

attributes.name: room_type_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the room type (e.g., Deluxe King, Standard Queen) to which this control applies.

attributes.name: advance_booking_limit_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days in advance that bookings can be made for this stay date. Null indicates no advance booking restriction.

attributes.name: channel_allocation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total sell limit allocated to this specific channel. Used for channel-level inventory gating. Sum across all channels for a date should not exceed 100%.

attributes.name: competitive_set_adr
attributes.description: Average Daily Rate of the competitive set (STR comp set) for comparable room types on this stay date. Used for competitive benchmarking.

attributes.name: control_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this inventory control record. Active controls are enforced by PMS and CRS; inactive controls are ignored.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory control record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cta_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether new arrivals are prohibited on this date. True means guests cannot check in on this date, but existing reservations spanning this date are allowed.

attributes.name: ctd_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether departures are prohibited on this date. True means guests cannot check out on this date; used to enforce minimum stay through high-demand periods.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record (hurdle_rate, forecast_adr, competitive_set_adr). Typically matches property base currency.

attributes.name: effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this control becomes effective. Controls are typically pushed to distribution channels in advance of the stay date.

attributes.name: expiration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this control expires and is no longer enforced. Null indicates control remains effective until explicitly superseded.

attributes.name: hurdle_rate
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable rate (ADR) below which the room type should not be sold for this date. Used by revenue management to protect yield. Expressed in property currency.

attributes.name: lra_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this room type participates in Last Room Availability programs with OTAs. True means OTAs can sell even when inventory is constrained, ensuring rate parity.

attributes.name: max_los
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive nights a guest can book when this date is the arrival date. Null indicates no maximum stay restriction.

attributes.name: min_advance_booking_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days in advance that bookings must be made for this stay date. Used to prevent last-minute bookings during high-demand periods.

attributes.name: min_los
attributes.description: Minimum number of consecutive nights a guest must book when this date is the arrival date. Null or 1 indicates no minimum stay restriction.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this inventory control record was last modified. Updated whenever any control parameter changes.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit_absolute
attributes.description: Absolute number of rooms above physical inventory that can be sold. Alternative to percentage-based overbooking. Null if percentage method is used.

attributes.name: overbooking_limit_pct
attributes.description: Percentage above physical inventory that can be sold to account for expected cancellations and no-shows. For example, 10.00 means allow 110% of physical rooms to be sold.

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the user when manually overriding RMS-generated controls. Required when override_user_id is populated.

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this control was last published to distribution channels (OTA, GDS, CRS). Null if control has not yet been distributed.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason code explaining why this control was applied (e.g., HIGH_DEMAND, RENOVATION, GROUP_BLOCK, SEASONAL_CLOSURE). Used for diagnostic and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rgi_target
attributes.description: Target Revenue Generation Index for this stay date. RGI measures property performance relative to competitive set. Value of 100 means at-market performance.

attributes.name: sell_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of rooms of this type that can be sold for the stay date. Null indicates no limit. This is the primary inventory cap enforced by the PMS and CRS.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin of this control record. RMS indicates generated by IDeaS G3 RMS; manual indicates user override; API indicates external system integration.

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this inventory control is effective. Controls are date-specific and define sell constraints for a single night of stay.

attributes.name: stop_sell_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all sales are stopped for this room type on this date. True means no new bookings are accepted regardless of availability. Overrides all other controls.

attributes.name: walk_risk_tolerance
attributes.description: Revenue management tolerance for walking guests (relocating to another property due to overbooking). Higher tolerance allows more aggressive overbooking.

products.name: room_block
products.description: Group or event room block record reserving a contracted quantity of rooms by room type for a defined date range and pickup period. Captures block code, block name, group/event association, contracted room-nights by type and date, cumulative pickup, release/cutoff dates, attrition percentage and penalty terms, wash factor, and block status lifecycle (tentative, definite, cancelled, released). Links to group reservations and event contracts. Supports group inventory management, attrition tracking, and block release decisions in Oracle OPERA PMS and Delphi by Amadeus.
products.reference: OPERA Group Block / Delphi Room Block

products.name: out_of_order
products.description: Out-of-Order (OOO) and Out-of-Service (OOS) designation record for individual rooms removed from sellable inventory. Captures OOO/OOS reason code, start date, expected return-to-service date, actual return date, responsible department, work order reference, and impact on RevPAR. Distinguishes between OOO (not counted in available inventory) and OOS (counted but not sold) per USALI standards. Managed in Oracle OPERA PMS.

tag_set.value: Impact on Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR)

attributes.name: lost_revenue_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated revenue loss due to the room being unavailable for sale during the out-of-order period. Calculated using ADR and occupancy forecasts for RevPAR impact analysis.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or special instructions related to the out-of-order condition and repair work.

attributes.name: ooo_code

Supports LOS-based revenue optimization strategies managed in IDeaS G3 RMS and distributed via Sabre SynXis CRS. Captures restriction type, effective date range, applicable channels, and override authority.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The first date on which this LOS restriction becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: full_pattern_los
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of exact LOS values allowed (e.g., '3,7,14' means only 3-night, 7-night, or 14-night stays are permitted). Null if restriction type is not full_pattern.

attributes.name: group_block_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether group block reservations are exempt from this LOS restriction. True if group blocks bypass this restriction, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this LOS restriction record was last modified.

attributes.description: Maximum number of nights a guest may stay when this restriction is active. Null if restriction type is not max_los.

attributes.name: min_los

attributes.name: occ_threshold_percent

attributes.name: override_reason_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a documented reason is required when this LOS restriction is overridden. True if reason is mandatory, false otherwise.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority of this restriction when multiple LOS restrictions apply to the same stay date and room type. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: restriction_code
attributes.description: Business code identifying this LOS restriction rule for operational reference and reporting.

attributes.name: restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, rationale, or special instructions for this LOS restriction. Used for operational communication and audit purposes.

attributes.name: restriction_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this LOS restriction: active (enforced), inactive (not enforced), suspended (temporarily disabled), or pending (scheduled for future activation).

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Type of LOS restriction: minimum LOS (MinLOS), maximum LOS (MaxLOS), full-pattern LOS requirement, closed to arrival (CTA), or closed to departure (CTD).

attributes.name: revenue_strategy_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the revenue management strategy or campaign that generated this LOS restriction (e.g., PEAK_DEMAND, SHOULDER_SEASON, EVENT_DRIVEN).

attributes.name: revpar_threshold_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount
attributes.description: RevPAR threshold amount that triggers or releases this LOS restriction. Used for dynamic restriction management based on revenue performance.

tag_set.value: Revenue Per Available Room (RevPAR) Threshold Amount

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the system that created or last modified this LOS restriction: OPERA (Oracle OPERA PMS), IDEAS (IDeaS G3 RMS), SYNXIS (Sabre SynXis CRS), EZRMS (Infor EzRMS), or MANUAL (manual entry).

attributes.name: stay_date
attributes.description: The specific date for which this LOS restriction applies. Represents the arrival or stay-through date depending on restriction logic.
