attributes.description: Foreign key linking to event.event_booking. Business justification: Channel bookings representing group room block pickups must link to the parent event booking for group block pickup tracking, attrition monitoring, and channel commission reconciliation against contra

attributes.name: guest_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the guest profile record associated with this booking. Enables guest-level channel attribution, loyalty linkage, and lifetime value analysis. PARTY_REFERENCE per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: inventory_room_type_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_type. Business justification: Channel bookings must reference the actual inventory room type sold for revenue attribution by room category, inventory consumption tracking, channel performance analysis, and commission calculation a

attributes.name: loyalty_member_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to loyalty.member. Business justification: Channel bookings must link to loyalty member for points accrual calculation, tier benefit application at booking time, member revenue attribution reporting, and loyalty program liability accounting. C

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Channel booking segmentation analysis (transient vs. group vs. corporate by channel) is a core revenue management report. The existing market_segment_code is denormalized; a FK to market_segment enabl

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.ota_partner. Business justification: OTA bookings require direct attribution to the OTA partner for commission reconciliation, performance reporting, and cost-of-acquisition analysis. While ota_partner is accessible via channel_booking.c

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property at which the booking is made. Links to the property master record for property-level channel performance analysis.

attributes.name: room_block_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.room_block. Business justification: Group block pickup tracking: when a channel booking consumes inventory from a contracted room block or allotment, the booking must reference the block for pickup percentage calculation, attrition pena

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate (ADR) for this booking, calculated as gross booking value divided by length of stay nights. Stored as a business attribute to support channel-level ADR benchmarking and STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring runtime calculation.

attributes.name: booking_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the channel booking transaction. Drives channel performance reporting, cancellation rate analysis, and no-show tracking. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: confirmed|cancelled|modified|no_show|waitlisted|tentative — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]

attributes.name: booking_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the booking was received through the distribution channel. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for booking pace analysis, lead time calculation, and channel demand pattern reporting.

attributes.name: cancellation_policy_code
attributes.description: The code identifying the cancellation policy applicable to this booking (e.g., FREE_CANCEL_24H, NRR_NON_REFUND, FLEX_48H). Determines penalty applicability and refund eligibility for cancelled bookings.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the booking was cancelled. Populated only when is_cancelled is True. Used for cancellation lead time analysis and channel cancellation pattern reporting.

attributes.name: channel_commission_amount
attributes.description: The commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner for this booking. Represents the cost of acquisition for channel-sourced bookings. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the distribution channel category through which the booking was received. Enables channel mix analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking across channel categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OTA|GDS|direct_web|voice|corporate|wholesaler|metasearch|travel_agent — promote to reference product if additional types are required]

attributes.name: check_in_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest arrival date for the stay associated with this booking. Used for stay date demand analysis, length-of-stay (LOS) calculation, and revenue period attribution.

attributes.name: check_out_date
attributes.description: The scheduled guest departure date for the stay associated with this booking. Combined with check_in_date to derive length of stay (LOS) and average length of stay (ALOS) metrics.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The commission rate percentage applied by the distribution channel for this booking (e.g., 15.00 for 15%). Used for commission structure analysis, channel cost benchmarking, and contract compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The per-booking connectivity or transaction fee charged by the channel technology provider (e.g., GDS segment fee, CRS transaction fee). Included in total cost-of-acquisition calculation alongside commission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was first created in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and ETL reconciliation.

attributes.name: crs_booking_reference
attributes.description: The unique booking identifier assigned by the Central Reservation System (Sabre SynXis CRS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between CRS and PMS booking records.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the booking was transacted by the distribution channel (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency revenue reconciliation and FX conversion in financial reporting. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: gds_segment_number
attributes.description: The segment identifier assigned by the Global Distribution System (GDS) for bookings originating through GDS channels (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport). Used for GDS billing reconciliation and travel agent attribution.

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross value of the booking as received from the distribution channel, inclusive of all room charges before deduction of channel commissions or fees. Expressed in the booking currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: is_cancelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been cancelled (True = cancelled, False = active). Used for channel-level cancellation rate analysis and net booking volume reporting.

attributes.name: is_modified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this booking has been modified after initial confirmation (True = modified, False = original booking). Used to track modification rates by channel and assess channel data quality.

attributes.name: is_rate_parity_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booked rate is compliant with the rate parity agreement for this channel (True = compliant, False = parity violation detected). Critical for OTA contract compliance monitoring and channel rate parity management.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this channel booking transaction record was last updated in the Silver layer data product. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for change data capture, incremental load processing, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The number of days between the booking timestamp and the check-in date. Stored as a business attribute to support lead time distribution analysis by channel, demand forecasting, and last-minute booking pattern identification.

attributes.name: length_of_stay_nights
attributes.description: The number of nights for the booked stay, derived from check-in and check-out dates. Stored as a business attribute to support LOS-based rate restriction analysis, minimum stay controls, and ALOS reporting without requiring date arithmetic at query time.

attributes.name: net_revenue_amount
attributes.description: The net revenue retained by the property after deduction of channel commission from the gross booking value. Primary metric for channel contribution analysis and cost-of-acquisition benchmarking. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: number_of_guests
attributes.description: The total number of guests included in this booking. Used for occupancy analysis, per-guest revenue calculations, and channel demand pattern reporting.

attributes.name: number_of_rooms
attributes.description: The number of rooms included in this booking transaction. Typically 1 for FIT (Free Independent Traveler) bookings; may be greater for group or multi-room bookings received through a channel.

attributes.name: ota_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The booking confirmation number assigned by the Online Travel Agency (OTA) platform (e.g., Booking.com, Expedia). Used for reconciliation with OTA partner systems and commission invoice matching.

attributes.name: pms_confirmation_number
attributes.description: The externally-communicated confirmation number generated by the Property Management System (Oracle OPERA PMS) for this booking. Serves as the primary guest-facing booking reference. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate type applied to this booking. BAR (Best Available Rate), LRA (Last Room Availability), NRR (Non-Refundable Rate), corporate, package, promotional, or group. Critical for rate parity monitoring and revenue strategy analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BAR|LRA|NRR|corporate|package|promotional|group — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_country
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the origin from which the booking was made through the channel. Used for geographic demand analysis, international vs. domestic channel mix reporting, and targeted marketing attribution.

attributes.name: travel_agent_iata_number
attributes.description: The 8-digit IATA (International Air Transport Association) accreditation number of the travel agency that made this booking. Used for travel agent commission processing, GDS attribution, and agency performance reporting.

products.name: commission_schedule
products.description: Master and transactional records for all channel distribution costs — the single source of truth for OTA commissions, GDS segment fees, CRS transaction fees, channel manager connectivity fees, and per-booking cost accruals. Captures commission/fee structures (percentage, flat, tiered), negotiated rates per partner, applicable rate plans, effective date ranges, property scope, fee types, billing frequencies, and per-booking accrual records with amounts in local and base currency. Supports commission invoice reconciliation, AP processing, total cost-of-acquisition calculation, technology cost management, and channel profitability analysis. Encompasses all cost types previously tracked separately (connectivity fees, per-segment fees, per-transaction fees) in a unified cost management product.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission or fee schedule record in the channel distribution cost management system. Primary key for the commission_schedule data product.

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Commission schedules define the commission terms negotiated in channel contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers. Adding nullable channel_contract_id FK links commission schedules to their governi

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rate plan (BAR, LRA, NRR, package, negotiated corporate) to which this commission schedule is scoped. Null indicates the schedule applies to all rate plans for the channel partner.

attributes.name: distribution_channel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel. Business justification: Commission schedules define fee structures for specific distribution channels. Many commission schedules per channel (e.g., tiered by volume, rate plan, market segment). Removes redundant channel_type

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Commission schedules are differentiated by market segment (corporate, leisure, consortia). Linking commission_schedule to market_segment normalizes the existing denormalized market_segment_code and su

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel partner (OTA, GDS, CRS, channel manager, direct booking engine) to which this commission or fee schedule applies. Links to the channel partner master record.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific property or hotel to which this commission schedule applies. Null or a portfolio-level sentinel value indicates the schedule applies across all properties (chain-wide agreement).

attributes.name: applies_to_cancellations
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is still payable when a booking is cancelled (True = commission owed on cancellations, False = commission waived on cancellations). Critical for NRR (Non-Refundable Rate) commission accrual and cancellation cost management.

attributes.name: applies_to_no_shows
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commission or fee is payable on no-show bookings (True = commission owed on no-shows, False = commission waived). Affects no-show revenue net-of-commission calculations and OTA contract compliance.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized approver (e.g., VP Revenue Management, CFO) who approved this commission schedule for execution. Required for SOX financial controls compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule was formally approved for activation. Part of the SOX-compliant approval audit trail for financial commitments.

attributes.name: auto_accrual_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether commission and fee accruals under this schedule are automatically calculated and posted to the GL upon booking confirmation (True) or require manual accrual processing (False). Supports automated AP accrual workflows in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the channel partner invoices the property for commissions or fees: monthly (most common for OTA commissions), weekly, per_booking (real-time deduction), quarterly, annual (common for connectivity subscription fees). Drives AP accrual scheduling and cash flow forecasting.

attributes.name: booking_window_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Null indicates no maximum booking window restriction. Used in conjunction with booking_window_min_days for last-minute rate commission scoping.

attributes.name: booking_window_min_days
attributes.description: Minimum advance booking window (in days before arrival) for which this commission schedule is applicable. Used for LOS (Length of Stay) and advance purchase rate plan commission scoping. Null indicates no minimum booking window restriction.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the commission or fee is calculated and accrued: per_booking (one charge per reservation), per_room_night (charge per occupied room night), per_segment (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction (CRS per-transaction charge), per_period (fixed charge per billing period regardless of volume). Drives accrual engine logic.

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Negotiated commission rate expressed as a percentage of the applicable revenue base (e.g., 15.0000 = 15%). Applicable when fee_structure is 'percentage'. Represents the contractually agreed OTA or agent commission rate. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this commission or fee schedule becomes contractually binding and applicable to bookings. Used to determine which schedule version applies to a given booking date for accrual and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this commission or fee schedule expires and is no longer applicable. Null indicates an open-ended agreement with no defined expiry. Used for schedule versioning and contract renewal tracking.

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the flat fee or tiered threshold amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency AP reconciliation and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: fee_structure
attributes.description: Defines how the commission or fee is calculated: percentage (applied as a % of booking revenue or room revenue), flat (fixed monetary amount per booking or period), tiered (rate varies by volume or revenue thresholds), per_unit (fixed amount per room-night, segment, or transaction unit). Determines the accrual calculation method.

attributes.name: fee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost type captured by this schedule: commission (percentage of booking revenue paid to OTA/agent), per_segment_fee (GDS per-segment charge), per_transaction_fee (CRS per-booking transaction fee), connectivity_fee (channel manager or switch connectivity charge), subscription_fee (fixed periodic platform fee), override_commission (negotiated override above standard rate). Drives AP coding and cost-of-acquisition (COA) categorization.

attributes.name: flat_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary fee amount per booking, segment, transaction, or billing period, expressed in the schedule currency. Applicable when fee_structure is 'flat' or 'per_unit'. Used for GDS per-segment fees, CRS per-transaction fees, and connectivity subscription fees. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which commission and fee expenses are posted for financial reporting under USALI. Ensures correct P&L classification of distribution costs (e.g., OTA commission expense, GDS fee expense) per USALI departmental accounting.

attributes.name: los_min_nights
attributes.description: Minimum Length of Stay (LOS) in nights required for this commission schedule to apply. Null indicates no LOS restriction. Supports commission scoping for extended-stay or minimum-stay rate plans.

attributes.name: max_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual cap on the commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period. Applicable for schedules with a commission ceiling clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: min_commission_amount
attributes.description: Contractual minimum commission or fee amount payable per booking or per billing period, regardless of the calculated percentage amount. Applicable for schedules with a commission floor clause. Expressed in fee_currency_code. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: negotiated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal team or individual (e.g., Revenue Management, Channel Distribution, Procurement) responsible for negotiating this commission schedule. Used for accountability tracking and contract ownership.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, special contractual conditions, negotiation history notes, or exceptions associated with this commission schedule. Not used for structured data; intended for operational reference by Revenue Management and AP teams.

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice receipt within which payment to the channel partner is due (e.g., 30 = Net 30). Used in AP aging analysis and cash flow management per SAP S/4HANA payment terms configuration.

attributes.name: rate_parity_monitored
attributes.description: Indicates whether rate parity compliance is contractually required and actively monitored for bookings under this commission schedule (True = rate parity clause in effect). Supports rate parity monitoring workflows and OTA contract compliance management.

attributes.name: revenue_base
attributes.description: Defines the revenue component on which the commission percentage is calculated: room_revenue (room charges only), total_revenue (all charges including F&B and ancillaries), net_revenue (after discounts and taxes), gross_revenue (before deductions), f_and_b_revenue (food and beverage charges only). Critical for accurate commission accrual and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission or fee schedule, used in AP reconciliation, contract references, and channel partner communications (e.g., OTA-EXP-COMM-2024, GDS-SAB-SEG-FEE).

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the commission or fee schedule, used in reporting dashboards, AP workflows, and channel profitability analysis (e.g., 'Expedia Standard OTA Commission FY2024', 'Sabre GDS Per-Segment Fee Q1 2024').

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission schedule: active (currently in force), inactive (temporarily suspended), pending (approved but not yet effective), expired (past effective_until date), terminated (cancelled before expiry), draft (under negotiation, not yet approved). Drives AP processing eligibility and accrual inclusion.

attributes.name: tier_1_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 1 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: Lower volume or revenue threshold (in booking count or currency amount) that triggers the Tier 1 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_2_rate_pct
attributes.description: Commission rate percentage applicable when booking volume or revenue falls within the Tier 2 threshold band in a tiered fee structure. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: Upper volume or revenue threshold that triggers the Tier 2 commission or fee rate in a tiered fee structure. Applicable when fee_structure is 'tiered'. Confidential as it reflects negotiated commercial terms.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this commission schedule record was last modified. Used for change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.

products.name: commission_accrual
products.description: Transactional records of commission amounts accrued per booking for each distribution channel. Captures booking reference, channel, OTA partner, stay date, commission schedule applied, gross booking value, commission rate, commission amount in local and base currency, accrual date, and payment status. Feeds into finance AP for commission invoice reconciliation and channel cost-of-acquisition reporting.
products.reference: OTA Commission Accrual / USALI Channel Cost

attributes.name: commission_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each commission accrual record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this transactional entity. ROLE: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: channel_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_contract. Business justification: Commission accruals represent financial obligations arising from channel contracts. While the path commission_accrual -> commission_schedule -> channel_contract exists, a direct channel_contract_id on

attributes.name: channel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel through which the booking was made (e.g., OTA, GDS, direct web, voice). Links to the channel master in the channel domain for channel mix and cost-of-acquisition reporting.

attributes.name: channel_rate_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to channel.channel_rate_plan. Business justification: Commission rates vary by channel rate plan. The commission_accrual table has rate_plan_code (STRING) which should be normalized to channel_rate_plan via FK. This links commission accruals to the speci

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission schedule or rate agreement applied to this accrual record. Determines the applicable commission rate tier, calculation method, and contractual terms with the OTA or GDS partner.

attributes.name: market_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to revenue.market_segment. Business justification: Commission cost-of-acquisition reporting by market segment is a standard revenue management KPI. Accruals currently carry a denormalized market_segment_code; a proper FK to market_segment enables norm

attributes.name: ota_partner_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OTA or GDS partner entity responsible for the booking. Populated when the channel type is OTA or GDS; null for direct bookings. Supports OTA partnership performance and commission reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: property_id
attributes.description: Reference to the hotel or resort property for which the commission is being accrued. Enables property-level commission cost reporting and CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) analysis.

attributes.name: reservation_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservation.reservation_booking. Business justification: Commission accruals must link directly to reservations for reconciliation, dispute resolution, cancellation-driven commission reversals, and complete audit trail from booking to financial posting. Cur

attributes.name: spa_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to spa.appointment. Business justification: OTA/GDS commission accruals for spa treatments booked via distribution channels must reference the originating spa appointment for spa-specific commission reporting, dispute resolution, and channel co

attributes.name: accrual_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the commission liability was recognized in the general ledger. Aligns with USALI period-end accrual practices and SAP S/4HANA GL posting date. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the commission accrual record. Drives AP (Accounts Payable) workflow in SAP S/4HANA: 'accrued' = liability recognized; 'invoiced' = OTA invoice received; 'paid' = payment disbursed; 'disputed' = under reconciliation review; 'cancelled' = booking cancelled before stay; 'reversed' = accrual reversed due to no-show or refund. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.

attributes.name: adr
attributes.description: The Average Daily Rate of the booking, calculated as gross_booking_value divided by room_nights. Stored for channel performance benchmarking and to support STR STAR Report comparisons without requiring recalculation from source.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the reservation was cancelled, if applicable. When populated, triggers commission accrual reversal logic per the cancellation policy terms. Null for active or completed bookings.

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution channel through which the booking originated. Drives commission rate tier selection and channel mix reporting. OTA = Online Travel Agency (e.g., Expedia, Booking.com); GDS = Global Distribution System (e.g., Sabre, Amadeus); direct_web = brand.com; voice = call center; corporate = negotiated corporate account; wholesale = tour operator/wholesaler.

attributes.name: commission_amount_base
attributes.description: The commission amount converted to the company's functional base currency (typically USD) for consolidated financial reporting and USALI-compliant P&L statements. Enables cross-property and cross-currency commission cost analysis. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: commission_amount_local
attributes.description: The calculated commission amount payable to the distribution channel partner in the local transaction currency (gross_booking_value × commission_rate). Used for OTA invoice reconciliation and AP liability posting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Defines the revenue base on which the commission rate is applied: 'room_revenue' = room charges only; 'total_revenue' = all charges including F&B and ancillary; 'net_revenue' = revenue net of taxes and fees; 'flat_fee' = fixed amount per booking regardless of revenue.

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The contractual commission rate applied to the gross booking value, expressed as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.15 = 15%). Sourced from the applicable commission schedule. Used to calculate the commission amount and for rate parity and cost-of-acquisition analysis.

attributes.name: commission_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission arrangement: 'standard' = default contractual rate; 'override' = manually overridden rate approved by revenue management; 'promotional' = time-limited promotional rate; 'group' = group booking commission; 'negotiated' = bilaterally negotiated rate outside standard schedule.

attributes.name: connectivity_fee_amount
attributes.description: The GDS or channel connectivity fee charged by the distribution technology provider (e.g., Sabre SynXis transaction fee) associated with this booking, in local currency. Included in total cost-of-acquisition (CoA) reporting alongside commission.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission accrual record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and SOX financial controls compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of a commission dispute with the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status is 'disputed'. Supports the channel dispute resolution workflow and AP reconciliation process.

attributes.name: fx_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate applied to convert the local currency commission amount to the base currency at the time of accrual. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA treasury rates. Required for accurate multi-currency financial reporting and audit trail.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA GL account code to which the commission expense is posted (e.g., USALI Schedule 6 - Sales and Marketing / Distribution Costs). Ensures correct financial statement classification per USALI and GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: gross_booking_value
attributes.description: The total gross booking value of the reservation on which commission is calculated, in the local transaction currency. Represents the full room revenue amount before any discounts or adjustments. Forms the base for commission rate application. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on the commission invoice received from the OTA or GDS partner. Used for AP aging analysis, payment due date calculation, and period-end accrual reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The OTA or GDS partner's invoice reference number received for commission payment. Used to match accrued commission liabilities against received invoices in SAP S/4HANA AP for three-way reconciliation. Null until invoice is received.

attributes.name: is_commissionable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the booking is eligible for commission payment (True) or is a non-commissionable booking (False), such as direct loyalty redemptions, staff rates, or complimentary stays. Drives commission accrual logic and AP posting.

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the booking was made and commission is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency commission reconciliation and FX conversion. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the commission payment was disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner. Populated when accrual_status transitions to 'paid'. Used for AP reconciliation and cash flow reporting.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual due date by which the commission payment must be disbursed to the OTA or GDS partner per the commission schedule terms. Used for AP cash flow planning and SLA compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment transaction reference or bank transfer reference number from SAP S/4HANA AP when the commission is disbursed. Enables end-to-end traceability from accrual to cash payment for audit and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: The reason code for reversing a previously accrued commission. Populated when accrual_status is 'reversed' or 'cancelled'. Supports AP reconciliation and channel dispute management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cancellation|no_show|rate_correction|duplicate|dispute_resolved|other — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]

attributes.name: room_nights
attributes.description: The number of room nights associated with the booking for which commission is being accrued. Used to calculate CPOR (Cost Per Occupied Room) and to normalize commission costs across bookings of varying LOS (Length of Stay).

attributes.name: total_cost_of_acquisition
attributes.description: The total distribution cost for this booking, combining commission_amount_local and connectivity_fee_amount. Represents the all-in cost of acquiring the booking through this channel. Used for channel profitability and net RevPAR analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission accrual record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, reconciliation audit trails, and SOX financial controls. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: channel_contract
products.description: Single source of truth is procurement.procurement_contract. Master records for commercial contracts with OTA partners and GDS providers, capturing contract type, effective and expiration dates, contracted commission rates, rate parity clauses, last-room-availability (LRA) obligations, preferred partner program terms, marketing co-op commitments, and dispute resolution terms. Distinct from commission_schedule (which captures the rate structure) — this is the legal agreement record. domains.name: fnb

attributes.name: pos_terminal_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the POS terminal or workstation where the check was processed. Used for system reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: requested_delivery_time
attributes.description: Guest-requested delivery time for room service or delivery orders. Null for dine-in and immediate service orders.

attributes.name: service_charge_amount
attributes.description: Mandatory service charge or gratuity added to the check, typically for large parties or banquet events. Distinct from discretionary tips.

attributes.name: service_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration in minutes from check open to check close. Used to analyze table turn time and service efficiency.

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Guest special requests or dietary instructions for the order. Examples: no nuts, extra spicy, gluten-free preparation.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all menu item charges before discounts, service charges, and taxes. Base revenue amount.

attributes.name: table_number
attributes.description: Table number or service location identifier where the guest was seated. Null for room service, takeaway, and delivery orders.

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: tender_amount
attributes.description: Amount tendered by the guest for payment. May exceed total_amount if change is due.

attributes.name: tip_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary gratuity amount added by the guest. Used for tip pooling and server compensation tracking.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount due including subtotal, service charges, taxes, minus discounts. Amount presented to guest for payment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this check record was last modified in the data warehouse. Used for change tracking and incremental processing.

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why the check was voided. Required for audit trail and revenue reconciliation. Null for non-voided checks.

products.name: pos_check_line
products.description: Line-item detail for each POS check, capturing the individual menu items ordered within a guest check. attributes.name: loyalty_promotion_id

attributes.name: parent_line_pos_check_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to another line item that this line is a modifier or add-on for. Null for standalone items. Enables hierarchical line item relationships for complex orders.

attributes.name: pos_check_id

attributes.name: cost_of_sales

attributes.description: Date and time when this line item record was first created in the POS system. Represents the moment the item was ordered by the guest or server.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Supports multi-currency operations and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to this line item. Includes promotional discounts, employee discounts, manager comps, and loyalty redemptions.

attributes.name: family_group_code
attributes.description: Mid-level menu category classification within major group. Examples: appetizers, entrees, desserts, wine, beer, spirits. Enables detailed menu mix reporting.

attributes.name: is_complimentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was provided as a complimentary item (no charge to guest). True for comps, false for paid items. Used for cost tracking and guest recovery analysis.

attributes.name: is_inclusive_tax
attributes.description: Indicates whether tax is included in the unit price (true) or added separately (false). Varies by jurisdiction and pricing strategy.

attributes.name: is_open_item
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line was entered as an open-priced item where the server manually entered the price rather than selecting from menu. Used for special items and manager overrides.

attributes.name: is_voided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item was voided after being ordered. True if voided, false if active. Voided lines are excluded from revenue but tracked for audit and waste analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item record was last updated. Tracks modifications such as quantity changes, price adjustments, or void actions.

attributes.name: line_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordering of this line item within the parent check. Determines display and printing order.

attributes.name: line_subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Extended amount for this line calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, before discounts and taxes. Base revenue for the line item.

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this line item including all charges, discounts, taxes, and service charges. Net revenue contribution from this line.

attributes.name: major_group_code
attributes.description: High-level menu category classification for this item. Examples: food, beverage, alcohol, non-alcohol. Used for USALI departmental reporting and revenue mix analysis.

attributes.name: modifier_text
attributes.description: Free-form text capturing cooking instructions, preparation preferences, add-ons, substitutions, and removals for this menu item. Examples: no onions, extra cheese, well done, gluten-free bun.

attributes.name: preparation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard kitchen preparation time for this menu item in minutes. Used for kitchen capacity planning and guest wait time estimation.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of this menu item ordered on this line. Supports fractional quantities for items sold by weight or partial portions.

attributes.name: seat_number

attributes.name: served_timestamp

attributes.name: service_charge_amount

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Selling price per unit of the menu item at the time of order. Reflects the base price before modifiers, discounts, or service charges.

attributes.name: void_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason this line item was voided. Examples: guest changed mind, kitchen error, wrong item entered, quality issue. Required when is_voided is true.

attributes.name: void_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this line item was voided. Null if not voided. Used for void pattern analysis and operational controls.

products.name: inventory_item

Captures item name, item category (food, beverage, dry goods, perishable, frozen, alcohol), unit of measure, par level, reorder point, standard cost, current on-hand quantity, storage location, supplier reference, shelf life, and ISO 22000 food safety classification (allergen, temperature-controlled). Distinct from the procurement domain's general inventory as this is F&B-specific with food safety attributes.

attributes.name: last_physical_count_quantity

attributes.name: last_purchase_cost

attributes.name: last_purchase_date

attributes.name: local_sourced_flag

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: par_level
attributes.description: Target inventory quantity that should be maintained to meet operational demand without overstocking. Used for automated reorder triggers.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum inventory quantity threshold that triggers a purchase requisition or reorder workflow. Calculated based on lead time and consumption rate.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days

attributes.name: standard_cost

products.name: stock_transaction
products.description: Single source of truth for all F&B inventory movements and waste events across outlets and storerooms. Captures transaction type (receipt, issue-to-outlet, inter-outlet transfer, spoilage, over-production waste, plate waste, breakage, expired stock, physical count adjustment, end-of-day consumption, return-to-vendor), item reference, quantity, unit cost, total cost, source location, destination location, transaction timestamp, and authorizing manager. For waste/spoilage transactions: waste category, waste reason, meal period, recording staff, and corrective action notes. Supports food cost variance analysis, par level management, sustainability reporting, waste reduction KPIs, and ISO 22000 stock traceability. Integrates waste tracking previously in separate waste logs to provide unified inventory and waste analytics.
products.reference: Oracle Hospitality MICROS POS Inventory Transactions / ISO 22000

products.name: recipe_ingredient
products.description: This association product represents the Recipe Ingredient relationship between recipe and inventory_item. It captures the precise quantity, unit of measure, preparation sequence, optionality, and waste factor for each ingredient within a specific recipe — the F&B Bill of Materials. Each record links one recipe to one inventory_item and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific recipe-ingredient combination. This is the operational foundation for food cost calculation, theoretical stock depletion from POS sales, and ISO 22000 ingredient-level traceability.. Existence Justification: In F&B operations, a recipe is composed of multiple inventory items (ingredients), and a single inventory item (e.g., olive oil, chicken breast) is used across many recipes. This recipe-ingredient relationship is the foundational Bill of Materials concept in every hospitality F&B management system — it is the operational backbone of food cost calculation, stock depletion from POS sales, and ISO 22000 ingredient traceability. The relationship carries rich per-combination data (quantity per portion, unit of measure, preparation step sequence, waste factor) that belongs to neither the recipe nor the inventory item alone.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the parent recipe that this ingredient line belongs to.

attributes.name: is_optional_ingredient
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ingredient is optional or a suggested substitution within the recipe (e.g., garnish, allergen-free alternative). Optional ingredients are excluded from mandatory food cost calculations but included in full BOM documentation. Belongs to the recipe-ingredient combination.

attributes.name: preparation_step_sequence
attributes.description: The sequential order in which this ingredient is introduced during recipe preparation. Supports structured kitchen workflow and is specific to each ingredient's role within a particular recipe. Belongs to the recipe-ingredient combination, not to the recipe or item alone.

attributes.name: quantity_per_portion
attributes.description: The precise quantity of this inventory item required to produce one standard portion of the recipe. Used for theoretical food cost calculation and automatic stock depletion from POS sales. Belongs to the recipe-ingredient combination, not to either entity alone.
attributes.references: Oracle Hospitality Materials Control — Recipe Line Quantity

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which this ingredient is specified within this recipe (e.g., grams, ml, each). May differ from the inventory item's stock UOM and requires a UOM conversion factor for accurate depletion. Belongs to the recipe-ingredient combination.

attributes.name: waste_factor_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of trim, peeling, or preparation waste applied to this ingredient when used in this specific recipe (e.g., 15% trim loss on carrots for this dish). Used to calculate the gross quantity to order versus the net quantity in the portion. Specific to the recipe-ingredient combination as waste varies by preparation method.

Captures planned headcount per shift, section configurations (floor/zone groupings with room counts and credit values), turndown service windows, and shift-level labor budgets aligned to CPOR targets. Used for labor planning, union CBA scheduling compliance (consecutive days, overtime thresholds), and PIP staffing requirements. Deep clean rotation scheduling is managed separately in deep_clean_plan.

products.name: attendant

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Primary housekeeping role classification. Determines work assignment types, productivity benchmarks, and labor cost allocation. Room attendants clean guest rooms, turndown attendants provide evening service, house persons handle heavy cleaning and linen transport, supervisors oversee sections, inspectors perform quality checks, and public area cleaners maintain lobbies and common spaces.

attributes.name: section_assignment

attributes.name: seniority_date

attributes.name: shift_assignment

AM shift typically covers morning checkout cleaning, PM shift handles afternoon turnovers and turndown service, night shift performs deep cleaning and public area maintenance. Room credits vary by room type: standard rooms = 1.0 credit, suites = 1.5-2.0 credits, checkout rooms = 1.2 credits, stayover rooms = 0.7 credits. Used for performance evaluation and labor cost per occupied room (CPOR) calculation.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the maintenance request record was first created in the database.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this request.

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total cost for completing the maintenance work, including labor and materials.

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Estimated time in minutes required to complete the maintenance work.

attributes.name: guest_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance issue impacts guest experience or room availability.

attributes.name: inspection_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the post-maintenance quality inspection was completed.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Notes and observations recorded during the post-maintenance quality inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_passed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the completed maintenance work passed the quality inspection.

attributes.name: inspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a quality inspection is required after maintenance work is completed.

attributes.name: issue_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the maintenance problem or issue reported.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost of labor for the maintenance work performed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the maintenance request record was last updated in the database.

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific location within the property or room where maintenance is needed (e.g., bathroom sink, ceiling near window).

attributes.name: maintenance_request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the maintenance request in the workflow from creation through completion.

attributes.name: materials_cost_amount
attributes.description: Cost of materials and supplies used in the maintenance work.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Urgency level assigned to the maintenance request, determining response time and resource allocation.

attributes.name: recurring_issue_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a recurring maintenance issue that has been reported multiple times.

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the maintenance issue was first reported or the request was created.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique business identifier for the maintenance request, typically displayed to staff and used in communications.

attributes.name: request_type

attributes.name: resolution_description

attributes.name: room_out_of_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance issue requires the room to be marked as out-of-order and unavailable for occupancy.

attributes.name: safety_hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the maintenance issue presents a safety hazard requiring immediate attention.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when maintenance work is scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: target_completion_timestamp
